correctness.rationale: Exact u_{n+1}=u_n^2 and z_{n+1}=(alpha_n I+(1-alpha_n)P)z_n identities; unitary diagonalization of P gives |lambda|^2=1-4alpha_n(1-alpha_n)sin^2(pi j/ell), proving sufficiency. For summable mixing, factoring near-P steps gives absolutely norm-convergent Q_n and exact finite cyclic accumulation sets. Nonvanishing fundamental Fourier products give necessity, with the lone order-two alpha=1/2 annihilation exception; a harmonic three-cycle gives exact log-product exponent 3/2. The embedded checker independently compares 2,961 exact rational finite iterates.

value.rationale: The fixed-parameter population dynamics leaves open how vanishing or intermittently nonmixing scheduled mutations compete with nonlinear radial relaxation. The theorem classifies all deterministic schedules by a natural summed dissipation, resolves the precise exceptional cancellation mechanism, exhibits persistent cyclic memories despite individually positive mixing, and proves a sharp n^(-3/2) critical relaxation law on a nontrivial three-cycle; these form a motivated structural nonautonomous classification beyond a parameter substitution.
